heroHigh.title: High School Diploma Recognition
heroHigh.subtitle: Guidance and support for individuals who need to recognize or validate a high school diploma obtained abroad for education, professional, or administrative purposes.

assistanceHigh.title: What We Can Assist With
assistanceHigh.subtitle: We provide guidance on the documentation and formalities that may be required to recognize foreign secondary education qualifications.

recognition.title: Recognition & Validation
recognition.description: Guidance on the applicable recognition, homologation, or validation procedure for your foreign secondary education qualification.

documentation.title: Diploma & Academic Records
documentation.description: Assistance identifying and organizing diplomas, transcripts, academic records, and other supporting documents.

authentication.title: Apostille & Legalization
authentication.description: Guidance on apostille, legalization, authentication, and other formalities that may be required for foreign educational documents.

translations.title: Certified Translations
translations.description: Guidance regarding certified or official translation requirements when educational documents need to be submitted in another language.
